context: WSP-184 was NEVER trained on original source; stopped at walk 1 source row count. WSP-185 verified actual original row counts without reading measured numerical sensor outputs. This is a NEW prospective cohort, NOT alteration or rerun of WSP184 prereg.
scientific_question: Does WSP184's tokenless contradiction-gated residual context memory improve real measured adaptive physical sensor predictions beyond independently FIT-trained batch autoregression, same-info EMA, and persistence when a physical chamber's instrument parameters change?

source.excluded_source_file: actuators_random_walk_1.csv; known 1016 readings, excluded BEFORE this experiment by WSP185 metadata

frozen_methods.reuse: WSP-184/physical_context.py as immutable imported source; WSP186 permits a separate roster loader ONLY and does not edit or rescope WSP184.
frozen_methods.features: five CURRENT public commanded actuator values (load_in, load_out, hatch, pot_1, pot_2) plus both sensor readings from the previous completed measurement; exclude current sensor values, hidden ground-truth regime flag, timestamp index/seed; first row of each walk cannot be scored.
frozen_methods.train: FIT-only normalized eight-feature causal ARX via direct recursive ridge least squares, lambda 0.01; independent full-batch ridge same FIT and features with <=1e-5 coefficient difference. No periodic validation/DEV model retrain.
frozen_methods.controls: fully FIT-trained batch ridge, same-public-history EMA bias alpha0.2, same-history sensor persistence. All controls and candidate receive identical observation stream.
frozen_methods.candidate: contradiction gate on 3 consecutive previous errors >1.5 FIT residual standard deviations, per output, gain0.2 and decay0.98. No post-DEV hyperparameter tuning.
frozen_methods.metrics: FIT-normalized RMSE both outputs and mean across outputs, on PUBLIC_DEV walk9-10, change regime first 200 measurements of each regime 1..31 and all 310,000 changed-regime measures; candidate gate compared to best actually scored control independently per output (oracle conservative screen).
frozen_methods.threshold: >=5% lower normalized RMSE on BOTH RPM and pressure during first 200 recorded measurements after each of 31 original physical regime transitions; equal frozen base checkpoint byte SHA256 pre/post, otherwise NO_GO.
frozen_methods.score_order: train FIT, select best conventional comparator by VALID only, then OPEN PUBLIC_DEV ONCE. Even if benchmark fails, preserve full scores, do not change any parameter, cohort, threshold or data alignment on same source.
frozen_methods.interpretation: developer evidence on preexisting public physical source measurements, NOT first-use, native Yggdrasil integration, causal graph discovery, unfamiliar world transfer, or SCIENTIFIC_PASS. Source instrument interventions within one chamber change configuration but not proof of new independently sourced causal worlds.
